藏品名称_EN: Sutra on the Wheel of Life and the Holy King, Volume 5
描述_EN: An edition of the Daizojing known as the Kaiyuanji edition was published at the Kaiyuanzen Temple in Fuzhou, Shaoxing, China, between the second year of the Northern Song Dynasty (1112) and the twenty-first year of the Southern Song Dynasty (1151). The publication date of this edition is 1148 (Shaoxing 18). The 50-volume edition of the Chinggong precepts (Baosheng edition) is a Chinese Buddhist treatise that summarizes the spiritual aspects of Buddhism through a collection of key passages from sutras, rituals, and treatises.
描述_ZN: 大藏经的一个版本被称为开元寺版，是在中国绍兴的福州开元禅寺在北宋二年（1112年）至南宋二十一年（1151年）之间出版的。 该版本的出版日期为1148年（绍兴18年）。 50卷本的清规戒律（宝胜版）是一部中国佛教论著，通过收集经、律、论中的关键段落，总结了佛教的精神层面。
